bug_semantics: In the barbuk theme's default python_venv segment, when neither CONDA_DEFAULT_ENV nor VIRTUAL_ENV_PROMPT is set and the current directory contains pyproject.toml, awk extracts the quoted requires-python value without filtering. __python_venv_prompt echoes that attacker-controlled value; __prompt-command captures the segment output and appends it directly to PS1. Thus a victim using the barbuk theme who cd's into an attacker-prepared directory emits embedded raw OSC/CSI/control bytes to the terminal on every prompt render, allowing terminal escape-sequence injection.
flaw_origin: PR #2367 was squash-merged to master as f4443b147be00b0c198efcf7adbf546d761418d1, but that aggregate is not the smallest BIC. GitHub's first-party PR commit list and the retained commit objects decompose it: member 2e53f8956f8c48b7138b556dca9b002f17d06562 ('Handle more dev tools') is the single member that added the pyproject.toml fallback, the unfiltered awk extraction of requires-python, and its echo into the prompt. Its direct parent 8417414a15ca085a05d4822e65e7bbbd48876e72 still only handled active Conda/virtualenv state and had no pyproject.toml/requires-python path.
ai_marker: No AI marker in the BIC commit object. `git cat-file -p 2e53f8956f8c48b7138b556dca9b002f17d06562` shows author and committer `BarbUk <julien.virey@gmail.com>`, a GPG signature, and only the message `Handle more dev tools` plus four ordinary description lines; there is no Co-authored-by, Generated-with, AI tool trailer, or bot identity.
evidence: First-party report https://github.com/Bash-it/bash-it/issues/2396 documents the exact path and raw-pty PoC: unfiltered requires-python is concatenated into PS1 and a raw OSC sequence appears adjacent to the version text on every render. First-party PR https://github.com/Bash-it/bash-it/pull/2397 records review of the initial approach, the source-level sanitation, and the final control-class strip.

In the clone, `git log --all --full-history --format=fuller -p -S'requires-python' -- themes/barbuk/barbuk.theme.bash` identifies master squash f4443b147be00b0c198efcf7adbf546d761418d1. `git log -L '/function __python_venv_prompt()/','/^}/':themes/barbuk/barbuk.theme.bash e7fb96930384b124bdfb4a8e1b4a5e9711cbca0c` traces the PR lineage to 2e53f8956f8c48b7138b556dca9b002f17d06562 and displays the exact added `awk -F'"' '/^requires-python/ {print $2}' pyproject.toml` path.

https://api.github.com/repos/Bash-it/bash-it/pulls/2367/commits lists the original PR members in order. The second member is 2e53f8956f8c48b7138b556dca9b002f17d06562 with parent 8417414a15ca085a05d4822e65e7bbbd48876e72. `git show 2e53f8956f8c48b7138b556dca9b002f17d06562 -- themes/barbuk/barbuk.theme.bash` shows that member alone adding the vulnerable fallback; `git grep -n -e requires-python -e pyproject.toml 8417414a15ca085a05d4822e65e7bbbd48876e72 -- themes/barbuk/barbuk.theme.bash` returns no matches, directly verifying parent absence.

`git show -s --format='%H tree=%T parent=%P' f4443b147be00b0c198efcf7adbf546d761418d1 e7fb96930384b124bdfb4a8e1b4a5e9711cbca0c` gives the same tree 5c55798c29723f30037d2249c0c8a86c4ecc17b5 for the master squash and PR tip, and `git diff --exit-code f4443b147be00b0c198efcf7adbf546d761418d1 e7fb96930384b124bdfb4a8e1b4a5e9711cbca0c` succeeds. This proves f4443b147be00b0c198efcf7adbf546d761418d1 is the aggregate of the decomposed PR rather than the smallest authoring commit.

Fix PR history is 0237810720c86f0e4b2083a5fc9b453c878c7675 (initial blanket strip), 496e52ec973beadb80bf4bceb97f176bd4c164f5 (revert because it broke legitimate color output), 7b7718c7e2a7f906e9bfcb988d547bfe0015b9e7 (sanitize requires-python at extraction), and 404bba0725abd6809e298199dc9a8555a1efb142 (final reviewed approach: retain source sanitation, remove `echo -e` from git_prompt_info, and strip `[[:cntrl:]]` from every segment). `git show -s --format='%H %P' 404bba0725abd6809e298199dc9a8555a1efb142` gives parent 7b7718c7e2a7f906e9bfcb988d547bfe0015b9e7.

The advisory-referenced merge fab8f57818f28bfc6f2a81f86a58981c4ea72e5a has parents 30415491e6118daea08477e92405d3a2b07c9b09 and direct PR tip 404bba0725abd6809e298199dc9a8555a1efb142. `git grep -n -e 'python_info=$(awk' -e 'info="${info//\[\[:cntrl:\]\]/}"' 30415491e6118daea08477e92405d3a2b07c9b09 -- themes/barbuk/barbuk.theme.bash` shows the vulnerable plain `{print $2}` extraction and no common-sink strip. The same command at fab8f57818f28bfc6f2a81f86a58981c4ea72e5a shows source-level `gsub` sanitation and `info="${info//[[:cntrl:]]/}"`; `git diff 30415491e6118daea08477e92405d3a2b07c9b09 fab8f57818f28bfc6f2a81f86a58981c4ea72e5a -- themes/barbuk/barbuk.theme.bash` reproduces the complete closing patch.

Release boundary is unusual and contradicts the advisory summary's literal tag wording: `git show -s v3.2.0` resolves to 0f04edce0ca93fbe66f1fe23c8d9b7a01e53f94c, which is the parent of master squash f4443b147be00b0c198efcf7adbf546d761418d1. Therefore the immutable v3.2.0 tag predates and lacks the flaw. `git merge-base --is-ancestor v3.2.0 f4443b147be00b0c198efcf7adbf546d761418d1` and `git merge-base --is-ancestor f4443b147be00b0c198efcf7adbf546d761418d1 fab8f57818f28bfc6f2a81f86a58981c4ea72e5a` both succeed. `git tag --contains` for either f4443b147be00b0c198efcf7adbf546d761418d1 or fab8f57818f28bfc6f2a81f86a58981c4ea72e5a returns no tags. The real affected boundary is unreleased master after f4443b147be00b0c198efcf7adbf546d761418d1 and before fab8f57818f28bfc6f2a81f86a58981c4ea72e5a; no tagged release contains the BIC, and the fix is likewise untagged in this history.

BIC-only AI check: raw `git cat-file -p 2e53f8956f8c48b7138b556dca9b002f17d06562` supplies the full commit object, identities, signature, and complete message. It contains no AI coauthor/generation trailer and neither identity is a bot; no PR text or later commit was used for the AI judgment.
reasoning: The security root cause is the new trust-boundary crossing introduced by 2e53f8956f8c48b7138b556dca9b002f17d06562: repository-controlled TOML becomes terminal-interpreted prompt output without neutralization. The direct parent lacks that input path, while both -S and -L history plus the original PR objects converge on this member. The master commit f4443b147be00b0c198efcf7adbf546d761418d1 merely squash-aggregates that member with unrelated theme work, so it is rejected as BIC. The final landed fix is merge fab8f57818f28bfc6f2a81f86a58981c4ea72e5a of direct tip 404bba0725abd6809e298199dc9a8555a1efb142; its branch history shows why the first blanket attempt was reverted and how the durable fix both sanitizes the untrusted extraction and strips control bytes at the common sink without destroying the git segment's colors. The raw BIC commit object attributes the work to human user BarbUk and has no AI marker, so under the required BIC-only rule the closed verdict is NOT_AI. The advisory's `3.2.0` label should not be interpreted as the immutable v3.2.0 tag: Git ancestry proves the tag is the introducer squash's parent and is not vulnerable.
